failure.body:
#### Description
caclmgrd process throws traceback

Sep 23 <IPV6>.993340 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 973, in <module>
Sep 23 <IPV6>.993535 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:     main()
Sep 23 <IPV6>.993577 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 969, in main
Sep 23 <IPV6>.993724 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:     [caclmgr.run](https://caclmgr.run/)()
Sep 23 <IPV6>.993764 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 854, in run
Sep 23 <IPV6>.993887 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:     self.update_control_plane_acls(namespace)
Sep 23 <IPV6>.993933 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 736, in update_control_plane_acls
Sep 23 <IPV6>.994062 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:     self.update_control_plane_nat_acls(namespace, service_to_source_ip_map)
Sep 23 <IPV6>.994100 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 746, in update_control_plane_nat_acls
Sep 23 <IPV6>.994255 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:     iptables_cmds = self.generate_fwd_traffic_from_namespace_to_host_commands(namespace, service_to_source_ip_map)
Sep 23 <IPV6>.994296 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 354, in generate_fwd_traffic_from_namespace_to_host_commands
Sep 23 <IPV6>.994388 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]:     for dst_port in  self.ACL_SERVICES[acl_service]["dst_ports"]:
Sep 23 <IPV6>.994434 sfd-t2-lc0 INFO caclmgrd[247606]: KeyError: 'dst_ports'

Looks like comming from
        "EXTERNAL_CLIENT": {
            "ip_protocols": ["tcp"],
            "multi_asic_ns_to_host_fwd":True
        },

This block is missing
            "dst_ports": ["8081"],

but there is no check-in  line 354 to ignore missing dst_ports

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Loaded 202205 based image on Chassis Line Card
2. During boot, observed the traceback and it caused acl test failure
3.

#### Describe the results you received:

calcmgr traceback as mentioned above

#### Describe the results you expected:
No traceback and no acl errors

#### Output of `show version`:

```
202205 sha1  77b469d7c87f04d6298d598936fe7d46dc7890b6

```
#### Output of `show techsupport`:

```
(paste your output here or download and attach the file here )
```

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):

resolution.title: [multi-asic] Fix the issue where if dest port is not specified in ACL rule than caclmgrd gets exception
resolution.description:
What I did:
Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/12179

Why I did:
Fix the issue where if dest port is not specified in ACL rule than for multi-asic where we create NAT rule to forward traffic from Namespace to host fail with exception.

How I verify:-
Added UT for the scenario.
